newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks mired in losses as bonds spiral lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mired in losses as bonds spiral lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks wallowed near the day's lows in late afternoon activity on Friday, unable to shake off the effects of a massive bond market sell-off.

The Dow industrials stood at 8114, off 108 points for the session. The losses among blue chips actually paled in comparison to those in the bond market, where the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury tumbled more than two full points, with the yield spiking up to 6.46 percent.
Market breadth remained decidedly negative, with declining issues outnumbering advancers by a 5-2 margin on volume approaching 430 million shares.
